Subject: Handing off: StratusPay private deployment - secure connect runbook

Hi Laura / infra team —

Thanks again for the sync this morning. Per our plan, the Customer Success handoff is here: Marissa (Solutions Eng) will own the technical implementation and run the network review; Neha will remain on the thread for commercial/contract questions; I’ll coordinate timelines and kickoff logistics.

I’m attaching the initial Secure Connect Runbook we drafted with the onboarding checklist and a reference network diagram. Please review the diagram and call out any IP ranges or private endpoint names you want used in the VPC peering and private endpoint step.

High-level next steps (actionable):
- StratusPay: confirm the list of CIDR blocks and a preferred maintenance window for peering (Dev->Prod separation).
- Redwood (Marissa): schedule the network review and share required egress rules and port list.
- Rohan: set tentative kickoff for week of Jun 21; will send calendar invite once dates align.

Attachments: redwood-secure-connect-runbook-v1.docx (runbook), stratuspay-network-diagram.png (diagram)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this into a dry-run with your infra team.

Best,
Rohan

Subject: Re: Handing off: StratusPay private deployment - secure connect runbook

Hi Rohan / Marissa —

Thanks for the doc. A few quick clarifications from our side:
1) CIDRs: our Prod VPC is 10.10.0.0/16 and Dev is 10.20.0.0/16. We plan to peer Prod only for the initial rollout.
2) Preferred maintenance window: weekdays 02:00–05:00 UTC (we can do weekends if that’s easier for you).
3) On-prem box: we may need the on‑prem package for disconnected testing. Can you confirm what the installer requires (OS, kernel version, and preinstalled packages)?

I’ll loop Dan (infra lead) for the deep technical review.

-L

Laura Chen
Director, Cloud Engineering | StratusPay
laura.chen@stratuspay.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handing off: StratusPay private deployment - secure connect runbook

Hi Laura / Dan —

Thanks — great context. A few technical notes from the runbook after an initial pass:
- VPC peering vs. PrivateLink: we recommend VPC peering for your Prod -> Redwood-hosted private endpoint because you want intra‑region low latency. We’ll provide route table entries and a short list of /32 endpoints.
- Egress rules: allow TCP 443 outbound to Redwood management IPs; if you plan to use the on-prem installer to seed models you’ll need outbound to our artifact repository on port 443 as well. Exact IPs are in section 3.2 of the attached runbook.
- Host requirements (on‑prem package): Ubuntu 20.04 or 22.04 LTS, Docker 20.10+, min 8 vCPUs/32GB RAM for test node, and NVMe or SSD for cache (~200GB). We can provide a docker-compose based lighter package or an air-gapped tarball — depends on whether you want automatic updates.

I’ve attached an updated checklist (onprem-install-checklist.xlsx) with specific kernel and package checks.

Proposed immediate next step: 60–90 minute network review with your infra leads and our infra SRE (Priyom) next week. We have slots Tue/Wed morning PT. What works for you?

Attachments: onprem-install-checklist.xlsx

Cheers,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Dan Morales <dan.morales@stratuspay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@stratuspay.com>
Cc: Infra Team <infra@stratuspay.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 14:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handing off: StratusPay private deployment - secure connect runbook

Marissa / team —

Thanks for the clarity. Couple of follow-ups from my infra checklist:
- We need the exact management IP list to lock down in our firewall (will prefer hostnames if possible).
- For the on‑prem package, does the installer require root, or can it run under a sudo user? We prefer non-root where possible.
- During peering there’s a brief window where routes update. Any recommended rollback plan if we see route flaps?

We can do the network review Wednesday 17 Jun at 10:00 PT. Please confirm attendee list.

-Dan
Dan Morales
Lead Infrastructure Engineer | StratusPay
dan.morales@stratuspay.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handing off: StratusPay private deployment - secure connect runbook

Dan / Laura / team —

I’ll be on the call Wednesday and bringing our infra SRE checklist. Quick answers:
- Management IPs: we’ll provide both hostname FQDNs and a short list of IPs ahead of the call (will send via separate email to avoid any quoting confusion).
- Installer privileges: the installer needs elevated privileges for kernel tun/tap and network namespace setup. We can provide a pre-validated sudoable script for non-root operations where possible and an air-gapped option for restricted environments.
- Rollback plan: during peering we recommend staging the route addition in a secondary route table and swapping it in once health checks pass; we’ll document the exact CLI steps for AWS and GCP in the runbook appendix.

Confirming attendees: Priyom (Redwood SRE), Marissa (Redwood SE), Dan & two infra engineers (StratusPay), Rohan (CS). I’ll send updated agenda and a read-ahead packet by EOD.

Thanks — Priyom
